text:
Alex: RCA is live for the 2026-03-20 text-gen latency incident. Doc: https://intranet.redwood/rca/2311117777. Brief: cache eviction storms during autoscale produced a wave of cold starts and request queuing. Full timeline, root cause, and mitigations in the doc.

Maria: Nice work. Can we bubble the critical actions to the top so reviewers see them immediately?

Alex: Done. Top actions now visible. Snapshot: 1) Change eviction policy to prefer long-lived prefixes (owner: Maria, target 2026-03-27). 2) Add autoscale warmup ramp + probe (owner: Sam, target 2026-03-24). 3) Canary plan + perf validation (owner: Priya, target 2026-03-26). 4) New alerts for cache miss surge (owner: Jen, target 2026-03-25).

Sam: I'll own the warmup. Question: prefer time-based ramp or metric-based probe as primary?

Jen: Recommend probe primary with a short fixed ramp fallback. We saw probe delays once and it left traffic in a hole.

Maria: I'll start the eviction-policy PR today and include safe defaults for dev/staging.

Priya: I'll build the perf matrix: steady, bursty, and prefix-heavy. Will include warmup simulations.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT TIMELINE: 2026-03-20 02:11 UTC first errors; 02:19 autoscale fired; 02:22 cache thrash; 02:45 partial mitigation (drain); 03:10 recovery. Full timeline: https://intranet.redwood/incidents/2311117777-timeline

Alex: Short action list (also in RCA):
- Maria: eviction config -> dev->staging (due 2026-03-27)
- Sam: implement ramp + probe (due 2026-03-24)
- Priya: perf validation + canary plan (due 2026-03-26)
- Jen: alerts + playbook steps (due 2026-03-25)
- Alex/Ops: schedule 1-week follow-up checkpoint (meeting 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC)

Maria: PR draft up, linking it in RCA. Will include rationale and test plan.

Sam: I'll prototype ramp in autoscaler branch and post a short demo clip. For local repro I used:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --latency http://staging-textgen.local/generate
```

Jen: Suggested alert: composite of `cache.miss_rate` and `instance.startup_latency`. If either >3x baseline, trigger canary rollback and paging.

Priya: I'll add rollout steps and risk notes in the RCA for SRE to run the canary. Starting canary at 5% and step to 50% over 30m if stable.

Alex: Added a "Rollout checklist" and rollback triggers in the doc. Owners: please confirm in-comments so we can close the loop before canary.

Sam: Adding canary config and probes to the PR. Will include a short runbook for oncall.

Maria: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate merging to staging after Priya's perf runs.

Priya: Ping @everyone 3: can owners add estimated blast radius and rollback notes? That helps oncall decide canary size.

Alex: Done. I added estimated risk levels and rollback commands to the RCA (look for "Risk & Rollback").

Jen: I'll pair with oncall for the initial canary and monitor the composite alert.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll mark eviction action assigned and update status in the RCA. Anything else?

Priya: Nothing else from me.

Alex: Thanks all 2: RCA published and follow-up checkpoint scheduled. Please post any blockers as comments on the doc. :thumbsup:
